name: expense-report
title: Expense claim
for_each: select id,ref from claims where status<>'draft' order by ref

sections.title: Claim
sections.sql: select t.ref,t.person,t.entity,t.title,c.purpose,t.status,t.submitted_on,t.decided_by,t.decided_on,c.decision_note from claim_totals t join claims c using (id) where t.id=$1

sections.title: Lines
sections.note: Amounts in the entity's currency, GST included. Evidence is the document held for each line.
sections.sql: select spent_on,merchant,category_name as category,gl_account,currency,amount_cents,home_cents,gst_cents,paid_by,evidence,coalesce(receipt,receipt_declaration) as receipt_or_declaration from line_work where claim_id=$1 order by spent_on

sections.title: Checks
sections.sql: select rule,finding from compliance_findings where ref=(select ref from claims where id=$1) or ref like (select ref from claims where id=$1)||' and %' or ref like '% and '||(select ref from claims where id=$1) order by rule

name: entertainment-register
title: Entertainment register
for_each: select id,name from entities order by code

sections.title: Entertainment this year, from 1 April
sections.note: Who attended and why, kept for FBT (Australia) and the 50% entertainment rules (New Zealand). Confirm treatment with your adviser.
sections.sql: select spent_on,ref,person,merchant,category_name as category,attendee_count,attendees,business_purpose,home_cents as total_cents,gst_cents from line_work where entertainment and entity_id=$1 and claim_status not in ('draft','rejected') and spent_on>=make_date(extract(year from current_date - interval '3 months')::int,4,1) order by spent_on

sections.title: Totals by category
sections.sql: select category_name as category,count(*)::int as lines,sum(attendee_count)::int as attendees,sum(home_cents)::bigint as total_cents,sum(gst_cents)::bigint as gst_cents from line_work where entertainment and entity_id=$1 and claim_status not in ('draft','rejected') and spent_on>=make_date(extract(year from current_date - interval '3 months')::int,4,1) group by 1 order by 1

name: payment-batch
title: Reimbursement batch
for_each: select id,ref from batches order by exported_on,ref

sections.title: Batch
sections.sql: select b.ref,e.name as entity,b.exported_on,b.claims,e.currency,b.total_cents,b.file,b.actor from batches b join entities e on e.id=b.entity_id where b.id=$1

sections.title: Pay each person
sections.note: Personal spend only. Company card spend is already paid.
sections.sql: select person,count(*)::int as claims,sum(reimburse_cents)::bigint as reimburse_cents from claim_totals where batch_id=$1 group by person order by person

sections.title: Claims
sections.sql: select ref,person,title,currency,total_cents,gst_cents,decided_by,decided_on from claim_totals where batch_id=$1 order by ref
